name: Trance
description: Tempo-synced trance drum kit with TR-909 ROM hi-hats. Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat. Four-on-the-floor kicks, clap on 2 and 4, offbeat 909 open hats. X thickens hats; Y builds clap rolls toward Fill. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill. Default ~138 BPM.

params.name: HATS
params.detail: 909 ROM offbeat open-hat energy and closed-hat density
